```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)
asset_dir <- "lfct_20x_track_summary_assets"
table_dir <- file.path(asset_dir, "tables")
figure_dir <- file.path(asset_dir, "figures")
cell_summary <- fread(file.path(table_dir, "cell_line_summary.csv"))
field_summary <- fread(file.path(table_dir, "field_summary.csv"))
metric_summary <- fread(file.path(table_dir, "cell_line_metric_summary.csv"))
```

## Scope

This report summarizes all 25 TrackMate annotation files supplied for the 20× LFCT sequences: 9 MCF10A fields, 6 HEK293 fields, 6 MDA-MB-231 fields, and 4 U87 fields. Distances are in pixels, durations are in frames, and speeds are in pixels per frame.

The analyses use the curated TrackMate graph. Movement summaries do not cross division or merge nodes. Field-level traces are retained throughout so that variation among fields is visible rather than hidden by pooling all detections from a cell line.

```{r cell-summary}
display_cell <- copy(cell_summary)
setnames(display_cell, c("cell_line", "n_fields", "n_frames_min", "n_frames_max", "n_detections", "n_tracks", "n_divisions", "median_field_duration", "median_field_speed", "median_field_nn", "median_isolated_5_fraction"),
         c("Cell line", "Fields", "Min frames", "Max frames", "Detections", "Tracks", "Divisions", "Median field track duration", "Median field speed", "Median field nearest neighbor", "Median isolated fraction (>5 px)"))
display_cell[, `Median isolated fraction (>5 px)` := sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * `Median isolated fraction (>5 px)`)]
kable(display_cell, digits = 2)
```

The following pooled quantiles use all eligible observations within each cell line. Directional-correlation columns give the mean cosine similarity at the stated lag; MSD alpha is calculated between lags 1 and 5.

```{r metric-summary}
display_metric <- copy(metric_summary)
setnames(display_metric,
  c("cell_line", "speed_q10", "speed_q25", "speed_median", "speed_mean", "speed_q75", "speed_q90", "duration_q10", "duration_q25", "duration_median", "duration_mean", "duration_q75", "duration_q90", "nn_q10", "nn_q25", "nn_median", "nn_mean", "nn_q75", "nn_q90", "isolated_5_fraction", "direction_corr_lag1", "direction_corr_lag3", "direction_corr_lag5", "msd_alpha_1_5"),
  c("Cell line", "Speed Q10", "Speed Q25", "Speed median", "Speed mean", "Speed Q75", "Speed Q90", "Duration Q10", "Duration Q25", "Duration median", "Duration mean", "Duration Q75", "Duration Q90", "NN Q10", "NN Q25", "NN median", "NN mean", "NN Q75", "NN Q90", "Isolated (>5 px)", "Direction C(1)", "Direction C(3)", "Direction C(5)", "MSD alpha 1:5"))
display_metric[, `Isolated (>5 px)` := sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * `Isolated (>5 px)`)]
kable(display_metric, digits = 2)
```

## Speed

Speed is calculated from consecutive linked positions. The first plot shows each field median, the pooled cell-line median, and the pooled 10th–90th percentile band. The second restricts the dark traces to movement steps whose two detections both meet the conservative isolation criterion.

```{r speed, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, "01_speed_over_time.png"))
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, "02_isolated_speed_over_time.png"))
```

## Cell spacing and conservative isolation

Nearest-neighbor distance is measured between spot centers. For isolation, the ordered ROI contour coordinates are converted to exact axis-aligned bounds. The distance between two such boxes is a conservative lower bound on the distance between their ROIs: a positive box gap guarantees that the corresponding ROI contours are separated, while a zero box gap is inconclusive. Thresholds of 0, 5, and 10 pixels show how conclusions change with the required margin.

```{r neighbors, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, "03_nearest_neighbor_over_time.png"))
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, "04_isolation_fraction_over_time.png"))
```

## Track duration

Track duration is the difference between the first and last frame in the TrackMate track. Tracks may contain lineage branches; field-level division counts are listed in the detailed table below.

```{r duration, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, "05_track_duration.png"))
```

## Directional persistence

Directional persistence is the cosine similarity between movement vectors separated by 1, 3, or 5 frames. A value near 1 means motion continues in the same direction, 0 indicates no directional alignment, and negative values indicate reversal. Comparisons stop at division or merge nodes.

```{r persistence, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, "06_directional_persistence_over_time.png"))
```

## Mean squared displacement persistence

The MSD curves summarize squared displacement over lags of 1, 3, 5, 10, and 20 frames. The time-resolved exponent is

$$\alpha_{1:5} = \frac{\log(\mathrm{MSD}_5 / \mathrm{MSD}_1)}{\log(5)}.$$

Values near 1 are consistent with diffusive motion over this lag range, while values near 2 indicate ballistic or strongly persistent motion. This is a descriptive finite-lag measure rather than a fitted mechanistic model.

```{r msd, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, "07_msd_curves.png"))
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, "08_msd_persistence_over_time.png"))
```

## Field-level summary

```{r field-summary}
display_field <- copy(field_summary)
setorder(display_field, cell_line, field)
setnames(display_field, c("cell_line", "field", "n_frames", "n_detections", "n_tracks", "n_divisions", "duration_q10", "duration_q25", "duration_median", "duration_mean", "duration_q75", "duration_q90", "track_speed_median", "confinement_median", "nn_center_median", "nn_box_gap_median", "isolated_5_fraction"),
         c("Cell line", "Field", "Frames", "Detections", "Tracks", "Divisions", "Duration Q10", "Duration Q25", "Duration median", "Duration mean", "Duration Q75", "Duration Q90", "Median track speed", "Median confinement ratio", "Median nearest neighbor", "Median ROI-box gap", "Isolated fraction (>5 px)"))
display_field[, `Isolated fraction (>5 px)` := sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * `Isolated fraction (>5 px)`)]
kable(display_field, digits = 2)
```

## Output tables

The report's companion directory contains machine-readable CSV files for the cell-line and field summaries, speed and neighbor time series, directional autocorrelation, MSD curves, and the MSD persistence time series.
